https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/faropoi:
Software Engineer
Location: Hoboken, NJ (on site)
About Faropoint
Faropoint is a real estate investment firm that buys and operates industrial properties (smaller warehouses close to where people live and work) across 20+ U.S. markets. We run the firm on software we build ourselves: our in-house technology team builds the production apps our investment teams use to source, underwrite, and manage billions of dollars in real estate deals.
What We Build
FarOS, our deal platform and system of record, where every acquisition is sourced, underwritten, and tracked.
REXy, our machine learning models that predict market rents, lease renewals, and sale prices.
AI agents that read broker emails and offering memos and turn them into deals in FarOS, help prepare lease negotiations, and take routine work off people’s plates.
The Faropoint Brain, our knowledge layer: an MCP server that gives Claude and our agents secure access to our leases, investment memos, data lake, and models.
Slack apps and dozens of internal tools that bring all of this to where people already work.
The Role
We’re a small team that ships fast. With AI coding agents, ideas go from a conversation with a user to production in days or weeks, not quarters. Writing code is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making sure what we ship is correct, tested, maintainable, and actually used.
You’ll work day to day alongside a senior software engineer and a data engineer across FarOS, our data platform, and our AI tools. You’ll start with the work that makes those platforms solid: migrations, testing, bug fixes, and tech debt. As you learn the systems, you’ll build new features, agents, and integrations, and own more of the platform.
We’re looking for an engineer, not a relay between us and an AI tool. You use coding agents every day, and you understand, check, and can explain everything they produce.
What You’ll Do
Ship and harden FarOS and our core platforms - Build, test, and maintain production software that powers Faropoint’s data and investment platforms (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL on AWS). - Strengthen the reliability and quality of existing systems through rigorous testing, debugging, and continuous improvement: migrations, bug fixes, and tech debt. - Take on scoped technical projects: dig into the problem, propose an approach and its trade-offs, then carry it out. - Help improve test automation, CI/CD, and developer tools such as automated AI code review.
Build AI agents and integrations - Extend our agents, MCP tools, and Slack apps so people can act without leaving the tools they use. - Wire our machine learning models and data platform into the products that rely on them.
Build with AI coding agents, and own the result - Make effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code every day, while taking full ownership of the correctness of everything you ship. - Review what agents produce for correctness, security, and fit with our existing patterns before it merges. - Write the tests, plans, and docs that let the next engineer, or agent, pick up where you left off.
Work with the people who use what you build - Partner closely with engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions. - Talk with users across the firm to understand their workflows, ship something small, and improve it based on feedback. - Pick up the business context as you go. No real estate background needed.
What You’ll Bring
Must-haves:  1 to 3 years of experience building and shipping production software. - A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline. - Strong programming skills and solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how a software project is organized. - Working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, and comfort with SQL and relational databases. - Comfort collaborating in Git: branches, pull requests, code review, and resolving merge conflicts. - Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and the judgment to verify their output. - The ability to explain code you didn’t write, including an agent’s, and talk through design trade-offs. - A demonstrated ability to learn quickly and carry projects through from start to finish. You test your own work and ask for help when you’re stuck. - A curious, self-driven mindset, and the communication skills to explain technical work to non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to have:  Experience building and testing a full-stack web app (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL; Jest, pytest, or Playwright). - Experience with database migrations or schema changes on a live system. - Exposure to AWS (Lambda, containers, S3) or CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions. - Experience building with LLMs, agents, MCP servers, or Slack apps. - Familiarity with financial models, spreadsheets, or an interest in finance, real estate, or investing.
Why Join?
Real impact. Your code is used every day to find, price, and manage real buildings.
Speed. A small team and a short path to production. You’ll see your work in users’ hands quickly.
Room to grow. Start with well-scoped work, then take on progressively greater technical ownership as you learn our systems.
Autonomy. You’ll choose how to solve problems, not just close tickets.
What We Offer
This position offers a base salary in the $120,000-$160,000 range, plus discretionary bonus, competitive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO, and a 401k match.
